mapper.select: SELECT f.fclt_id AS fcltId, f.fclt_nm AS fcltNm, f.fclt_se_cd AS fcltSeCd, f.ctpv_nm AS ctpvNm, COALESCE(c.code_item_name, f.sgg_nm) AS sggNm, f.road_nm_addr AS roadNmAddr, f.lat, f.lot, f.opn_yn AS opnYn, f.use_yn AS useYn, f.fclt_area AS fcltArea, f.fclt_capacity AS fcltCapacity, f.reg_dt AS regDt FROM ofsafe_facility f LEFT JOIN code_item c ON f.sgg_nm = c.code_item_id AND c.code_group_id = 'AREA_JB' WHERE f.fclt_id = #{fcltId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ofsafe_facility SET fclt_nm = #{fcltNm}, fclt_se_cd = #{fcltSeCd}, ctpv_nm = #{ctpvNm}, sgg_nm = #{sggNm}, road_nm_addr = #{roadNmAddr}, lat = #{lat}, lot = #{lot}, opn_yn = #{opnYn}, use_yn = #{useYn}, fclt_area = #{fcltArea}, fclt_capacity = #{fcltCapacity} WHERE fclt_id = #{fcltId}
mapper.select:
SELECT f.fclt_id as fcltId, f.fclt_nm as fcltNm, f.fclt_se_cd as fcltSeCd, f.ctpv_nm as ctpvNm, COALESCE(c.code_item_name, f.sgg_nm) AS sggNm, -- 여기서 글자로 변환 f.road_nm_addr as roadNmAddr, f.lat, f.lot, f.fclt_area as fcltArea, f.fclt_capacity as fcltCapacity, f.opn_yn as opnYn, f.use_yn as useYn, f.reg_dt as regDt,
(6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{userLat})) * cos(radians(f.lat)) * cos(radians(f.lot) - radians(#{userLot})) + sin(radians(#{userLat})) * sin(radians(f.lat))))
0 AS distance FROM ofsafe_facility f LEFT JOIN code_item c ON f.sgg_nm = c.code_item_id AND c.code_group_id = 'AREA_JB'
AND (f.sgg_nm = #{sggNm} OR c.code_item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sggNm}, '%'))
AND f.fclt_se_cd = #{fcltSeCd}
AND (
f.road_nm_addr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roadNmAddr}, '%')
OR
f.fclt_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fcltNm}, '%')
)
ORDER BY
distance ASC
f.${sortKey} ${sortOrder}
f.fclt_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ofsafe_facility
AND road_nm_addr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roadNmAddr}, '%')
AND sgg_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sggNm}, '%')
AND fclt_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fcltNm}, '%')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ofsafe_facility ( fclt_nm, fclt_se_cd, ctpv_nm, sgg_nm, road_nm_addr, lat, lot, opn_yn, use_yn, fclt_area, fclt_capacity, reg_dt ) VALUES
( #{item.fcltNm}, #{item.fcltSeCd}, #{item.ctpvNm}, #{item.sggNm}, #{item.roadNmAddr}, #{item.lat}, #{item.lot}, COALESCE(#{item.opnYn}, 'Y'), 'Y', #{item.fcltArea}, #{item.fcltCapacity}, NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fclt_se_cd = VALUES(fclt_se_cd), ctpv_nm = VALUES(ctpv_nm), sgg_nm = VALUES(sgg_nm), road_nm_addr = VALUES(road_nm_addr), lat = VALUES(lat), lot = VALUES(lot), opn_yn = VALUES(opn_yn), fclt_area = VALUES(fclt_area), fclt_capacity = VALUES(fclt_capacity), reg_dt = NOW()
